title: How to Prepare for Tattoo Removal
h1: How to prepare for laser tattoo removal
desc: How to prepare for laser tattoo removal: sun protection, shaving, skincare, medicines and what to expect at your first session in Dubai Marina.
answer: Before laser tattoo removal, keep the tattoo out of the sun for at least 2 weeks, shave the area on the day if needed, avoid self-tanner and strong skincare on it, and tell us about any medicines, especially ones that make skin sun-sensitive. Arrive with clean skin and no lotion on the tattoo.
facts: Photos of the tattoo when new
body:
## At your first visit

We check the tattoo, discuss colours and sessions, take photos to track progress and may do a test spot. Afterwards, follow our [aftercare guide](/blog/tattoo-removal-aftercare/).
faq: Can I remove a new tattoo?
Wait until it has fully healed, usually at least 6 to 8 weeks.
Not before; avoid intense exercise for 24 hours after.
